name: ticker-tape-deltas
title: Ticker Tape Deltas
description: A stock-quote tape: symbols scroll horizontally while up/down deltas render as triangle glyphs with tabular numerals, ticking live values and flashing the cell background on change like a trading terminal.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
